subject.title: Session Routing Bugs: CLI routing to wrong session, WeChat ID inconsistency, and session deadlock from message flooding

question: Should this bundled report be split into separate canonical issues for TUI default-session routing, WeChat/core routing ownership, background-event flood isolation, and the existing meaningful-activity timestamp issue?
rationale: The source gaps are real, but the correct fix boundary crosses core session semantics, external channel plugin ownership, and product choices about background-event handling.

options.title: Split into focused canonical issues
options.body: Create or confirm one owner-scoped item per remaining behavior, link the already-fixed WeChat selector PRs and https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/51028, then queue only reproducible narrow fixes.

options.title: Keep this as the umbrella
options.body: Use this issue as the canonical tracker, but require maintainer-authored acceptance criteria before any automation attempts code changes.

options.title: Close after partial fixes
options.body: Close only if maintainers decide the remaining CLI, flood, and activity-model concerns are no longer product goals or are fully covered elsewhere.

recommendation.title: Split into focused canonical issues
recommendation.body: Create or confirm one owner-scoped item per remaining behavior, link the already-fixed WeChat selector PRs and https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/51028, then queue only reproducible narrow fixes.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete owns the most recent broad explicit-recipient session routing change and is best positioned to choose the cross-surface split.
